title: Frozen Trail First Look: Content highlights from October 8
body:
# Frozen Trail First Look: Content highlights from October 8

Raiders,

The Frozen Trail Update is close at hand. Are you prepared to suit up and confront whatever waits beyond the Rust Belt?

Before October 8 arrives, we want to show you what's coming. Venturing into this new frontier will push you to your limits, but you'll also get new ways to grow your abilities and get ready for the danger ahead.

Below is a look at what Frozen Trail has to offer.

# New Map: Pendola Pass

With your assistance, Celeste and Shani have pinpointed where the odd signal echoing through Toledo is coming from. Every clue leads to Pendola Pass, an aging Italian village that once served as an Exodus transport hub.

Past the mountains that surround the Rust Belt, freezing air holds Pendola Pass in an unsettling stillness. Remnants of the old world dot the narrow area: a supermarket and an empty town square. Traces of the Exodus Project are also visible, including an observatory and a buried train depot that once functioned as a key transit point.

Yet the biggest draw of Pendola Pass overshadows everything else - one of the Emperors has gone down. Valuable technology sits inside it, and your task is straightforward: reach it, and find a way in.

Between a disrupted ARC presence and violent flash freezes tearing through the valley, this will be a dangerous journey. Do you feel ready for what's waiting past the Rust Belt?

# Frigate

A downed Emperor is a rare event, and ARC has responded swiftly. They've deployed one of their biggest vessels to patrol the region - Raiders have nicknamed it the Frigate.

The Frigate offers a serious test for skilled Raiders who see a chance worth the risk. Once you find a way aboard, you'll have to work through its inner corridors, open up new routes, and hold your ground against both familiar and new ARC threats.

You won't be the only one there, though. Other Raiders want the same reward, meaning you'll either need to team up with them or fight your way past. The size of this challenge might call for tactics different from what you're used to - when you're pinned down in tight spaces hundreds of feet above ground, you'll need to figure out the right approach, whatever that looks like.

# New Enemy: Bully

True to its name, the Bully is a relentless, aggressive machine-learned foe that charges straight at you and refuses to back off, unleashing a range of deadly attacks. Stay behind cover, time your moves carefully, and land your shots - the Bully moves fast and shows no restraint in its pursuit.

# New Enemy: Skulker

Unlike the Bully, the Skulker prefers patience. It lurks at the edge of your vision, waiting to ambush you with a rapid series of strikes. Watch closely - even a brief distraction lets it vanish, and it will come back to strike again when you least expect it.

# New Enemy: Hydra

This enemy doesn't move around, but it's far from harmless. Made up of three stacked, independently operating sections, the Hydra functions as a turret capable of overwhelming entire squads with three separate weapon systems at once. Located aboard the Frigate, the Hydra demands a smart plan - Raiders will need to split its attention, find cover fast, and strike quickly when an opening appears.

# Raider Den Extension: Outpost

Celeste offers a new base to Raiders willing to answer her call and explore Pendola Pass: the Outpost. Positioned between the Rust Belt and the dangerous mountains beyond, the Outpost marks the first step toward reclaiming ground on the surface.

You can customize the Outpost with various modules and decorate the inside with furniture. The Research Workstation lets you explore new elements of the world, unlocking higher-tier weapon customization and modding options to prepare you for what lies past the mountains.

The Outpost is only the beginning of a feature we plan to expand significantly, with the goal of eventually giving players a truly personal space where they can shape the Raider they want to become.

# Amplified Weapons

Frozen Trail brings new weapons to add to your collection, but we also wanted to make a deeper change to how combat feels in the late game. We've noticed that experienced Raiders tend to stick to a handful of favorite weapons, leaving many others rarely used. To address this, we've built an upgrade system that reshapes some of the guns you're already familiar with.

By using the fully-upgraded Research Workstation at your Outpost, Raiders can unlock a fifth quality tier for a selection of weapons. This tier opens a branching set of abilities and enhancements capable of drastically altering how a weapon performs - think a fully-automatic Burletta, a scoped Renegade, or a Rattler firing incendiary rounds from a 64-bullet magazine.

The goal is to let late-game players rework their loadouts and customize weapons with top-tier upgrades that make them stand out. This system is launching for 15 weapons, with additional ones planned down the line.

# New Weapon: Stiletto

The Stiletto is a light-ammo battle rifle designed as an early-game option alongside the Renegade. It's inexpensive to build and simple to handle, making it a solid choice for Raiders with steady aim who want to engage from range. Its fire rate can be quick, but spamming the trigger will hurt your accuracy - stay steady and make your shots count.

# New Weapon: Bantam

The Bantam is a compact revolver that fires heavy ammo capable of punching straight through enemies. It works well against both ARC and rival Raiders, and comes with a special hip-fire feature that lets you play out your cowboy fantasy, even with cold hands.

# Grappling Hook

We wanted to bring in gadgets and items that open up new playstyles and movement options. Enter the Grapple Hook, which lets you scale hard-to-reach areas, rappel down buildings, and swing across wide gaps. Creative Raiders will discover entirely new ways to move through the terrain.

# Tethers

As part of our broader system built around tethers and restraints, we've added two new gadgets that let you disrupt your enemies. The Tether Launcher connects two points with a wire, locking targets in place for an easy takedown - or even tying a Raider to an ARC unit and watching them get dragged off. The Yank Grenade works on a similar idea, but detonates to violently pull a nearby target toward it. It's ideal for slamming flying ARC units to the ground or yanking enemy Raiders out of cover.

# Camera

The Rust Belt has no shortage of amateur photographers and Topside journalists. We've noticed some striking shots taken using the Binoculars, which is why we're adding a fully functional camera gadget. It launches with features like zoom, aperture control, manual and automatic focus racking, and even a selfie mode with a set of custom emotes. Photos are saved to your Codex, so you can look back on your best moments from the safety of home.

# Instruments

Two new instruments are arriving Topside this October: the Harmonica and the Banjo (its blueprint comes with the Collector Set DLC). Bring the sound of southern swamps to the Rust Belt this fall - time to get the band back together.

# Weapon Stencils

Add some personal flair to your weapons with the new Weapon Stencils arriving in the Frozen Trail update. Make sure enemies know exactly who took them down - but be careful, because Raiders who defeat you will happily claim your customized weapon as their own.

# Reward Pass

Frozen Trail also introduces a new progression system called the Reward Pass. These passes build on the earlier Raider Decks, giving you a way to try out all the new items and content from the update.

* The Free Pass unlocks a series of rewards through earned XP, including 200 Raider Tokens, five new outfits, new gameplay items, and 20 cosmetic items such as Scrappy Outfits, Furniture, Charms, Attachments, and Emotes.

* The Premium Pass is built for Raiders who want to get the most from the update. It includes premium versions of all outfits, exclusive colorways, weapon stencils, hairstyles, and 1,150 Raider Tokens.

* The Legacy Pass is free for every Raider and merges all existing Raider Decks together, so none of your prior progress is lost and you can keep earning those rewards.

# Collector Set DLC

For Raiders who want the complete Frozen Trail experience, the Collector Set DLC includes both the free and premium Reward Pass tracks, plus a new cosmetic set, the Renzo, the Dragon's Breath Weapon Stencil, the Bob Hair Style, and 2,400 Raider Tokens.

# See you Topside

Join us on October 8 for all of this and more, including new questlines and improvements, a reworked Skill Tree with new and improved skills, and a new Map Condition. We're looking forward to welcoming you to the new frontier.

On Friday, September 25 at 6pm CEST, we'll host a developer Q&A livestream focused on the Frozen Trail update. Tune in live and send in your questions about the First Look event.

Gear up. Dress warm. See you Topside.
